truck-exhaust-plumes-opposite-directions.description: Opening exterior (00:02-00:07): dark plume behind the parked cab drifts up-left while a pale ground-level cloud by the front bumper (no visible exhaust source) drifts right toward the diner at the same moment. Reported by router-s1 and router-s3 (environment-response). Frame crops at 1/2.5/4/5.5/7 s confirm both clouds and the opposite drift; a weak, low-salience defect (wind shear could be argued).

phone-screen-sunpatch-flicker.description: phone: the hard-edged sunlit patch on the phone screen jumps position/shape and blinks on and off between consecutive frames (clearest 04:50-08:25, e.g. on 06:50, off 06:75, on 07:00, off 07:25-07:75, on 08:00) while phone, hands and background light are essentially static; reported in all 6 layers (core-s1/s2/s3, router-s1/s2/s3); confirmed in 24 fps frames 06:40-07:40, patch changes from large top-left blob to none to centre blob frame-to-frame.

pour-cup-refills-after-empty.description: Glass pouring cup is visibly empty and inverted 8.5-9.5 s, then shows green olive content at 9.75 s with no refill. Reported by core-s1, core-s2, core-s3, router-s1 (4 layers). Frames 35-40 confirm empty cup at 8.5-9.5 and a green olive-like mass in the cup at 9.75 (at frame edge, last frame, so moderate confidence).

steel-bowl-olives-regrow.description: After the scoop leaves ~1-2 green olives in the steel bowl (5.25 s), the green count rises to ~3 (6.0-6.75 s) and ~5 (8.25-9.75 s) with nothing added. Reported by router-s1, router-s2 (x2), router-s3 (x2); core-s1 object-persistence|1 also mentions it but was classed OLIV-4 for its main claim. Frames 22/25/28/34/36/40 confirm the increase, though camera angle shifts between 5.25 and 6.0 s.

skate-green-face-blob.description: Skateboarder: a saturated green glowing blob sits over the skater's eye/cheek at 0.5-1.0 s and moves with the face, absent before and after. Reported by core-s1 (2 roles) and core-s2. Frames 3-5 clearly show it on the face; the sun is near the head, so a green lens-flare ghost is a possible innocent reading.

skate-floaty-airtime.description: Skateboarder: first flat-ground flip trick stays airborne ~1.6-1.8 s (pop ~1.25-1.5 s, touchdown ~3.0-3.25 s) with rider and board hovering at near-constant height ~1.75-2.75 s; second trick ~1.3 s. Reported by all six layers (core-s1/s2/s3, router-s1/s2/s3; 11 findings). Frames confirm the long hang (frames 7-13 all airborne, rider tucked high against the sky); caveat: could be read as a slow-motion beat, though the approach plays at normal speed.

skate-deck-underside-color.description: Skateboarder: during the first trick the truck side of the deck is black at 1.75-2.0 s, plain light wood at 2.5 s, dark again at 2.75 s, and grey/white in the second trick (~8.25 s). Reported by core-s1, core-s2, core-s3 (5 findings). Frames show the black-with-trucks / wood-with-trucks / dark sequence; a kickflip rotation could partly explain it. Adjacent to SKAT-1 (same moment, board underside rendered wrong) but a different symptom (colour, not wheel count/placement), so KT may want to fold it into SKAT-1 or reject it.

home-tour-cardigan-becomes-crewneck.description: Woman's top changes from an open V-neck cardigan over a white camisole (00:00) to a closed high crew-neck fitted top (00:03.0 onward) in one continuous take; reported by core-s1 (baseline, character-continuity), core-s2 (character-continuity), core-s3 (baseline, character-continuity); frames 1 vs 13 clearly confirm. Caveat: borders KT's rejected 'wardrobe micro-morphs' class, but this is a whole-garment/neckline change, not a seam/earring detail.

dancer-exit-sign-garbled.description: dancer-mirror: the real green EXIT sign above the left door renders as a two-glyph ƎΠ-like shape rather than EXIT (reflected signs also malformed); single layer (router-s1, conf 0.3); 3x crop of the 05:50 frame supports it, but the sign is ~25 px so compression could contribute. By the corroboration rule this is single-run only.

skate-shirt-logo-text.description: Skateboarder: chest logo on the black T-shirt is pseudo-lettering whose shape changes across frames. Single report (core-s1 baseline only). Frames show an unreadable red/green/white logo. Confirmed 'garbled text' class elsewhere, but uncorroborated here.

home-tour-garbled-panel-over-bed-paintin.description: A smeared, garbled light rectangular panel hangs over the lower part of the painting above the bed (00:04.75-00:05.5); core-s2 baseline only; frames 20-22 show the odd overlapping panel extending below the frame, though it could be read as a chandelier pendant/hanging decoration, so weak and single-layer.
